selectedDefinition: Apply n -> 0,1,2,3+ uniformly to all six pair buckets before forming the sorted exchange triangle.

findings.statement: Uniform six-bucket saturation at 3 is scalar-exact on all three hard carriers; exact bucket counts above 3 are unnecessary in the tested common carrier.
On 4x5-k4, uniform clip-at-2 leaves fourteen scalar contradictions, while clip-at-3 eliminates them. The distinction between count 2 and count >=3 is load-bearing somewhere in the six-bucket carrier.

ZOE is insufficient at this late exchange-count layer on 4x5-k4, leaving forty-seven contradictions. The earlier component-multiplicity ZOE law therefore does not transfer unchanged to the six exchange buckets.
Bucket parity loses the scalar map on every demanding common test where contradictions are observable: 12 on 6x3-k3, 97 on 4x5-k4, and 1 on 6x3-k4.

Relative to exact six counts, clip-at-3 removes one structural direction on 6x3-k3 and one on 4x5-k4 while preserving scalar image dimensions, showing the exact count tail beyond 3+ is value-null on the declared carriers.

dpMss.nextAxis: Determine which of C,D,A bucket families specifically require 3+ versus 2+ or coarser state.

nextQuestion: Which of the three semantic bucket families C={C+,C-}, D={D+,D-}, A={A+,A-} actually require the 3+ saturation state, and can the others use clip2/ZOE/presence without scalar loss?
nonclaims: Uniform clip3 is selected only within the frozen EW-RS-075 uniform-transform ladder.
This result does not imply clip3 is the component-multiplicity count law; it applies only to the six late exchange buckets.
No individual bucket coefficient or syndrome is frozen.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
